description: Generated by dev/sync_status_codes.py from the Testbench package. Do not edit.

labels.CANNOT_EXECUTE_FLOW_TRIGGER: A flow or process prevented the save: {message}
labels.CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY: Circular reference: {fields}. It points at a record that leads back to it, so the chain loops and neither can be created first. Point it at a different record, or remove the reference.
labels.DATA_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: A data template used here isn't available in this org: it has no active version, or its active version failed to deploy. Activate the data template, or correct the failed version and activate it again, or remove the reference to it.
labels.DATA_TEMPLATE_RECORD_NOT_FOUND: The data template loaded by this test no longer contains the record this step references. Its active version may have changed. Point the step at a record the template still creates, or remove the reference.
labels.DATA_TEMPLATE_STEP_FAILED: A step inside a data template used here did not complete, so the records it should have created are missing or incomplete.
labels.DUPLICATES_DETECTED: A duplicate rule was triggered. {api_name} was triggered on fields: {fields}.
labels.EXCEPTION_NOT_FOUND: An error was expected to have happened, but none occurred.
labels.EXCEPTION_STATUS_CODE_NOT_FOUND: An error with status code {expected} was expected to have happened, but this status code has not occurred.
labels.EXCEPTION_TYPE_NOT_FOUND: An error of type {expected} was expected to have happened, but this type has not occurred.
labels.FIELD_NOT_FOUND: Field {fields} does not exist on this object.
labels.FIELD_VALUE_MISMATCH: {fields} did not match the expected value. Expected was {operator} {expected}, but the actual value was {actual}.
labels.INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS_ON_CROSS_REFERENCE_E: {fields} points at a record the user can't access. Check that the record exists, and that the persona the test runs as can see it.
labels.INVALID_CROSS_REFERENCE_KEY: {fields} points at a record that doesn't exist. If that record comes from a data template, it was not created: validate the data template to see why. Otherwise, correct the reference.
labels.INVALID_EMAIL_ADDRESS: {fields} does not contain a valid email address.
labels.INVALID_OR_NULL_FOR_RESTRICTED_PICKLIST: Invalid or null value for {fields}. This is a restricted picklist.
labels.NUMBER_OUTSIDE_VALID_RANGE: The value for {fields} is outside the valid range.
labels.OBJECT_NOT_FOUND: Object type '{api_name}' does not exist in this org and cannot be used to create or update records.
labels.OPERATOR_NOT_SUPPORTED: The filter on {fields} uses the operator '{expected}', which a search cannot apply. Open the step and choose the operator again from the list.
labels.PERSONA_ASSIGNMENT_REJECTED: Salesforce refused to assign {fields}: {message} The persona runs without it.
labels.PERSONA_DATA_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: Lookups point at data template records that weren't created: {fields}. Those values weren't applied. Activate the data template if it isn't active, or validate it to see why it didn't create them. Otherwise, remove the lookups from the persona.
labels.PERSONA_GROUP_NOT_FOUND: Public groups or queues not found: {fields}. The persona runs without these memberships, so sharing that depends on them doesn't apply. Create them here, or remove them from the persona.
labels.PERSONA_INCOMPLETE: A persona used here was created with problems, so it may not behave as its definition says.
labels.PERSONA_NOT_CREATED: A persona used here could not be created, so nothing here can run as it or point at it.
labels.PERSONA_NOT_FOUND: A persona used here isn't available in this org: it has no active version, or its active version failed to deploy. Activate the persona, or correct the failed version and activate it again, or remove the reference to it.
labels.PERSONA_PERMISSION_SET_GROUP_NOT_FOUND: Permission set groups not found: {fields}. They don't exist in this org, so the persona runs without them. Create them here, or remove them from the persona.
labels.PERSONA_PERMISSION_SET_LICENSE_NOT_FOUND: Permission set licenses not available: {fields}. A license has to exist and be active in this org before it can be assigned. Check the licenses here, or remove them from the persona.
labels.PERSONA_PERMISSION_SET_NOT_FOUND: Permission sets not found: {fields}. They don't exist in this org, so the persona runs without them. Create them here, or remove them from the persona.
labels.PERSONA_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: Profile not found: {fields}. Either this org has no profile with that name, or the user the tests run as can't see it, which needs View All Profiles. Standard profile names differ between orgs set to different languages, so pick the matching profile in this org and save the persona again.
labels.PERSONA_REFERENCE_NOT_RESOLVED: Left unset because the persona they name could not be created: {fields}. The record was still saved, with the platform's defaults in those fields. Activate that persona if it isn't active, or validate it to see why it couldn't be created. Otherwise, point the fields at something else.
labels.PERSONA_ROLE_NOT_FOUND: Role not found: {fields}. No role has that developer name in this org. Create it, or pick an existing role and save the persona again.
labels.PERSONA_TERRITORY_MANAGEMENT_DISABLED: Territories can't be assigned: {fields}. Enterprise Territory Management isn't enabled in this org. Enable it, or remove the territories from the persona.
labels.PERSONA_TERRITORY_NOT_FOUND: Territories not found: {fields}. The persona runs without them. Create them here, or remove them from the persona.
labels.PERSONA_USER_FIELD_NOT_FOUND: User fields not found: {fields}. They don't exist in this org, so those values weren't applied. Add them to this org, or remove them from the persona.
labels.PERSONA_USER_FIELD_VALUE_INVALID: Values that don't fit their field: {fields}. These fields exist, but the values don't match what they accept, so they weren't applied. Check each value's format and range.
labels.PRINCIPAL_NOT_FOUND: No match was found for {fields} with the name '{expected}'. Either this org has no such profile, role, permission set, permission set group or permission set license, or the user that runs the tests cannot see it. Profiles in particular are only visible to a user holding View All Profiles — check that permission on the integration user configured for the Testbench API connection.
labels.RECORD_COUNT_MISMATCH: Record count did not match expectations. Expected was {operator} {expected} but actual value was {actual}.
labels.RECORD_TYPE_NOT_FOUND: No record type '{expected}' exists on this object. A record type is stored by its developer name — the API name in Setup, not the label shown to users — so it must match exactly. An unset record type does not stop the record being created — the platform applies the object's default instead — so this run did not exercise the record type this step names.
labels.REFERENCE_WRONG_OBJECT: {fields} points at the wrong kind of record. The record it points at is not of a type this field accepts. Point it at a record of the right type.
labels.REFERRED_RECORD_NOT_FOUND: This step acts on a record an earlier step should have produced, and that record does not exist. The step that would have created it reports why.
labels.STRING_TOO_LONG: String value is too long for the field: {fields}.
labels.TEST_CLASS_COULD_NOT_RUN: This test's generated class could no longer run in this org. Re-activate the test to regenerate it.
labels.TEST_RUN_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED: This org has used its daily allowance of Apex test runs, so the run could not be started. The allowance is set by Salesforce and shared with everything else in the org, and it resets each day. Wait for the reset and run the test again.
labels.VALUE_CONVERSION_FAILED: The value '{expected}' is not valid for {fields}. Check its format and range — a date must be a real date, a time must be a real time, and a number must fit within what the field allows.

fallback.withMessage: The operation failed. The Salesforce error message is: {message} (exception type {exception_type}, status code {status_code}).
fallback.withoutMessage: The operation failed (exception type {exception_type}, status code {status_code}).
